typed_schemas.GenericWorldCondition: one lexical case scoped hypothetical physical antecedent
typed_schemas.ObserverHorizon: opaque observer O and horizon H
typed_schemas.SourceSlot: P/Q in H with declared adjacency
typed_schemas.PhysicalWind: immutable ID, source, kind and ordered phase states
typed_schemas.SunState: Sun at source at ordered phase
typed_schemas.MaterialState: M lifted or not lifted at source
typed_schemas.WindAnchor: written physical Wind ID plus source/horizon/current phase state/provenance
typed_schemas.WorldPredicate: asserted physics relation inside generic conditional
typed_schemas.Certificate: written origin or cessation evidence tied to actual physical events
typed_schemas.PhaseCursor: ordered phase integer; no measured interval

additional_prices.explicit_N_to_E_episode_bridge: pchedeey consumes N current anchor; E is dependent continuation, not independent holdout
lexical_setup_assignments: Windu active as conditional antecedent atphase0/sourceP
additional_prices.written_non_aiin_anchor_alias: oteey world-origin assertion then exact anchor operation, both paid; no productive aiin spelling claim
additional_prices.sunrise_solar_event_expansion: each WITHDRAW records Sun departure and caused cessation at one ordered phase; APPROACH records Sun arrival and raised material at later phase; GENERATE at still later phase
additional_prices.strict_unknown_bridge_policy: unknown taints bindings; no execution beyond it until explicit CASE_SETUP. Partial counters retain exact entries and available tainted inputs, not assumed-inert words.
additional_prices.alias_policy: every added form is individually priced even when same family/predicate; literal variants remain separate entries, no reader substitution
